$comment: Fields to ADD to the existing OnSocial Base44 entities (existing fields are unchanged). Apply with update_entity_schema or the Base44 editor. See docs/BASE44_INTEGRATION.md.

data_sources.description: Provenance per field: { field_name: { source, url, fetched_at, note } }. source is one of google_places, meta_graph, facebook_graph, serpapi, apify, manual. Values without an entry here are shown as 'not available' in reports.

market_position.description: Quadrant from the competitor position table

market_rank.description: Rank in the local market (1 = strongest)

market_position_score.description: Composite market position score 0-100, relative to the local cohort

out_of_radius.description: No longer returned by Google Places within the search radius; excluded from reports

data_source.description: Record-level source when per-field provenance is not available

competitor_table.description: Full competitor market-position table (rows, columns, scores, citations) from buildCompetitorTable

analytical_report.description: Output of the Analytical Agent: findings, metrics, concentration, relationships, data quality, methodology

analytical_summary.description: Executive analysis narrative (LLM text kept only if every number is verified against the data)

data_sources.description: Numbered citation list used by the footnotes

api_keys.description: Add meta_ig_user_id next to the existing keys.

meta_ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business account ID of the agency (needed for Business Discovery lookups of other accounts)
